description: Stop a session's running turn, as the person pressing Escape would. Says so when nothing is running. Use it only when the person asks you to. Held to the target machine's steer setting as gruntas_message is, and works for the same sessions. Answers take a few seconds: other machines are asked at their next refresh.

session.description: The session's id, as gruntas_status lists it.

name: gruntas_interrupt
